Every GET endpoint response is validated against its @glossops/shared Zod schema
pnpm --filter api test:e2e passes in a clean environment with only Docker available

globalSetup starts Testcontainers (Postgres + Redis) and seeds base data
E2E suites cover critical flows: login, create customer, create work order, complete work order
Tests run with a single command: pnpm test:e2e from repo root
Tests run headless in CI without requiring a deployed environment
